scenario: Synthetic FlowRelay version comparison; no real product claims
question: Can version 2.2 be recommended over 2.1 for deduplication and throughput?

documents.text: FlowRelay 2.1 uses at-least-once delivery. It has no request-id deduplication. A benchmark measured 700 messages per second on four CPU cores.

FlowRelay 2.2 offers optional request-id deduplication. The option must be enabled and a request ID supplied. The deduplication window is 24 hours. A benchmark measured 910 messages per second on eight CPU cores.

cases.claim: Version 2.2 supports optional deduplication when enabled and supplied a request ID.
cases.excerpt: The option must be enabled and a request ID supplied.
Deduplication is always enabled by default.

cases.claim: Version 2.2 enables deduplication by default without a request ID.
cases.excerpt: The option must be enabled and a request ID supplied.

cases.claim: Version 2.2 improves throughput by 30 percent because of its software changes.
